key_insight: A patient-level multimodal MIL framework that fuses ultrasound image and clinical information improved preoperative differentiation of phyllodes tumors from fibroadenomas.
clinical_relevance: Better PT vs FA triage could reduce unnecessary surgery while helping ensure patients with phyllodes tumors receive complete excision with negative margins.
method: Encoded multiple breast ultrasound views per patient with an ultrasound foundation model.
Aggregated image instances with attention-based multiple instance learning to produce a patient-level image score.
Combined the image score with a gradient-boosted clinical score using logistic score fusion.
evidence_signal: In patient-level 5-fold cross-validation, logistic score fusion reached 0.780 AUC-ROC and outperformed clinical-only, image-only, and end-to-end multimodal baselines.
watch_item: The model was evaluated retrospectively in cross-validation, so prospective validation and workflow integration are still needed before clinical use.
paper_title: Multimodal Multiple Instance Learning for Fibroepithelial Tumor Diagnosis in Breast Ultrasound
